intro: Bust Bloom Oil is an ayurvedic massage oil designed to support bust area skincare through firming, toning, and improved smoothness, helping the shape look better with consistent use. The lightweight base spreads easily and absorbs fast without greasiness while providing nourishing care. For best results, apply on clean skin and massage regularly over 8–12 weeks; individual results may vary. External use only; perform a patch test before first use.
